text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Electoral Boundaries Review Committee proposes system of 83 members of parliament in 15 Group Representation Constituencies and nine single-seat wards.
- Taiwan county magistrate and seven other people shot dead by masked gunmen in Mafia-style attack.
- First Capital Corporation continues landbanking spree, offering Singapore $275.6 million top bid for Bishan plot.
- Singapore Central Provident Fund Board keeps savings rate unchanged at 3.48 percent per annum.
- Treasury profits jump 21 percent over 1994 to Singapore $1.39 billion.
- New housing launches held back following weak turnover and price trends in recent months.
- Nobel Design Holdings' initial public offering 124.75 times subscribed.
- Deputy U.S. Trade representative Jeffrey Lang says information technology agreement main element that would make next month's World Trade Organisation meeting a success.
- New mobile phone operator, Wireless Communications Services, eyes listing in Singapore.
- Singapore-listed Total Access Communication's mobile phone concession extended by another five years till the year 2018.
- Hong Kong property stock Hong Kong Land tops actives list at U.S. $2.78 on day when Singapore property stocks also surged.
- Listed Electronic Resources raises Singapore $20.6 million through placement of 13.4 million new ordinary shares of 10 cents each at $1.55 per share.
